name: Saiga Conservation Alliance Small Grants Programme
summary: Grants of up to £5,000 for individuals, organisations and institutions in Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Uzbekistan and saiga consumer countries for field conservation, research, community engagement and education work on saigas.

geography.label: Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Uzbekistan and saiga consumer countries

calls.label: 2027 round
calls.note: Applications close September 2027 per the funder's key dates.

status.quote: Key dates Applications open August 2027 Applications close September 2027

applicant_types.quote: Open to individuals, organisations, and institutions proposing projects that contribute to saiga conservation.

geography.quote: Applicants must be based in Kazakhstan, Mongolia, or Uzbekistan, or in a saiga consumer country, including China, Singapore, Vietnam, and Malaysia.

access.quote: Applications are submitted through an online form.

window.quote: Key dates Applications open August 2027 Applications close September 2027

amount.quote: Up to £5,000 in funding for an individual project.
